text:
anya: spotted plaintext DB URL in partner chart upload to staging bucket - gs://redwood-staging-charts/partner-z/0.9.7/values.yaml

samir: path and snippet pls

anya: inside extra.env: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://svc_ingest:plainpass@staging-db:5432/ingest_db

luca: CI scan missed it since partner pushed directly. quarantine the object and remove public read now.

oncall: doing IAM change: will remove partner CI write and move file to gs://sec-evidence/INC-3301239999/values.yaml

devops-bot: ACL update applied by oncall at 3301240005 - object moved to sec-evidence and public ACL removed

samir: Triage: staging-only for now. Actions: 1) rotate staging DB user, 2) search audit logs for svc_ingest activity, 3) check Vault for wrapped artifacts referencing old transit key.

luca: running rotate script now -> ./infra/scripts/pg-rotate-user.sh --db=staging-db --user=svc_ingest --to=svc_ingest_rot1

anya: snapshotting audit logs before touching rewraps: gcloud logging read 'logName="projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access"' --limit 1000 --format=json > /tmp/audit-snap.json

samir: Who can check Vault? look for secret/partner-z/* entries with wrapped values.

luca: found secret/partner-z/producer -> wrapped_blob: w-xyz. will coordinate rewrap if needed.

oncall: partner CI attempted a reupload to quarantine after IAM change; no plaintext detected.

luca: rotate done at 3301240030, wrote new creds to secret/data/staging/db/svc_ingest_rot1, marked old secret as deprecated (do not delete).

samir: deploy canary via ConfigSync to one staging pod and monitor for auth errors for 10m; rollback threshold >5% auth failures.

devops-bot: canary triggered at 3301240042

anya: canary pod connected successfully. monitoring 12m.

samir: if canary steady, revoke old user and run rewrap utility for `w-xyz` with temporary KMS key, snapshot audits after. schedule partner onboarding follow-up to enforce server-side secret scanning.

oncall: revocation scheduled at 3301240200 pending canary health.

security-bot: INC-3301239999 created and assigned. Update will be posted when rotation/rewrap complete.
